event: 43 Copa del Rey MAPFRE - ORC European Championship
parties: TUR 2206 - KIM - TEAM CANTABRIA LABS - Yann LYTHGOE
procedural_matters: TUR 2206 was represented by Yann Lythgoe (tactician).
ESP 3773 was represented by Hernan Mones Ruiz (helm).
AUT 255 was represented by Jordi Amoros (helm)
Ana Margarida Constantino (crew member of TUR 2206) and Albert Roig (crew member of AUT 255) attended the hearing as observers.
Cxema Pico (chairman of the panel of the International Jury) acted as interpreter for Hernan Mones Ruiz (representative of ESP 3773) during the hearing.
The panel of the International Jury provided tracking evidence of the incident.

During the hearing the protest committee clarified in accordance with RRS 63.2(c) that the hearing request was not only a [original type] but also a [request for redress] […] and proceeded with it accordingly.
The panel of the International Jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
facts: TUR 2206, ESP 3773 and AUT 225 are all 12 m long.
The conditions at the time of the incident in race 1 for ORC B were 11 knots of wind and small chop.
TUR 2206 and AUT 255 were sailing downwind on starboard tack and were approaching the gate mark that was to be left to starboard.
ESP 3773 was sailing on port tack and was approaching the same mark.

When entering the zone of the gate mark, AUT 255 was overlapped to windward of TUR 2206 at a lateral distance of 1 boat length and her bow slightly ahead. ESP 3773 was overlapped to windward of AUT 255 at a lateral distance of 3 boat lengths.
ESP 3773 rounded the gate mark at a lateral distance of less than 5 m and was clear ahead of AUT 255 and TUR 2206 then.
When AUT 255 was abeam of the mark and had a lateral distance of approximately 20 m to it, she bore away even further. The distance between AUT 255 and TUR 2206 was less than 5 m at this time.
When AUT 255 bore away, TUR 2206 immediately also bore away from the mark.
TUR 2206 began to round the mark at a lateral distance of 25 m and 20 m clear astern of ESP 3773.
conclusions: TUR 2206 outside overlapped at the zone gave ESP 3773 and AUT 255 mark-room, as required by RRS 18.2(a) (1).
AUT 255 outside overlapped at the zone gave ESP 3773 mark-room, as required by RRS 18.2(a)(1)
AUT 255 to windward failed to keep clear of TUR 2206 to leeward, and broke RRS 11.
Since AUT 225 was not sailing within the mark-room to which she was entitled under RRS 18.2(a)(1) when she broke RRS 11, she is not exonerated under RRS 43.1(b) for this breach.
